 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Bimlesh Kumar Pandey, Advocate
 Mr. Anjali Kumari, Advocate

For the State : Mr.Umeshanand Pandit, Addl Public Prose
 for opposite party no.2 Mr. Zainul Abedin, Advocate

=======================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, the State and the opposite party no.2.

The petitioner who is husband of opposite party no. 2 apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 498A/120B and other allied sections of the Indian Penal Code and under sections  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner offers and undertakes that he is ready to give maintenance amount of Rs. 3000/-per month, starting from this month, to opposite party no. 2.

In view of the undertaking of learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is ready to give maintenance amount of Rs. 3000/- per month, in the event of arrest/surrender within a period of six weeks from today, above-named petitioner be Patna High Court CR.
